correctness.rationale: The real \(\ell_3^2\) plane satisfies the symmetry hypothesis of the cited reduction. Reciprocal symmetry \(F(1/t)=F(t)\) reduces the domain to \([0,1]\). Independent symbolic expansion gives \(9W-(U+V)=18t^2\) on \([0,1/2]\) and \(2(1-6t+21t^2-8t^3)>0\) on \([1/2,1]\). Concavity of \(s^{2/3}\) then yields the global upper bound \(\sqrt[3]{162}/5\), and the coordinate pair \((1,0),(0,1)\) attains equality. The finite checker is corroborative only; the continuum supremum is proved analytically.
